description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Hourglass of the Lost that is a 4/4 artifact creature named Mishra's Warform with haste.
Activate Mishra's Warform's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
